blurb: Hippophile Farm offers specialized care for horses including seasonal and year-round boarding with stall, bedding, feed, hay, and daily turnout. Lessons are available privately or in groups for all ages and levels, focusing on horsemanship, equitation, and effective aids. Training includes groundwork, starting young horses, and customized programs based on horse ability and owner goals.
